The notebook expressly reports that affirmative correction, costly candor, and acceptance-of-scrutiny examples were not located; that favorable search remains incomplete rather than proving their absence.","missing_source_type":"Primary full judgments/votes and case dispositions are needed for the cited court-summary claims; appointment-level relationship/competence records, audited asset and campaign-finance records, and final MEC, police-interference, and jewelry dispositions are needed for the principal personal-integrity attribution gaps.","official_claim_independence":"The core adverse findings come from independent judicial institutions, not executive self-claims. CGU/GSI material in WD008 is self-defensive and needs independent records for any stronger concealment inference; WD011 bundles agency reporting with referenced TCU material without a precise underlying TCU locator.","open_system_complaint_volume":"The notebook correctly warns that open-media and fact-check visibility, article volume, and repeated statements can inflate apparent severity. this creates a duplicate-counting and attribution risk.","WD010 and WD011 are procedurally and substantively limited but are labeled final evidence in the ledger; downstream use must preserve their allegation/unresolved status.","WD008 and WD011 refer to additional underlying material without precise locators, and WD005 relies partly on linked individual checks;
